content.thinking: הכותרת מדברת על איפה הכי זול להשקיע במדד, וזה אני. S&P 500 כבר נבחר, והסכומים המוצגים (84,184 ₪ ו-86,492 ₪) לא תואמים את 30,000 שציינתי, אז אני רק מציין את זה ונמשיך לגלול.

Leumi and Hapoalim are ranked well below the top account, which is roughly 15,000 ₪ more than what I pay at my bank, and its fees are far lower. The fund tags and the -533 ₪ figure are terms I don't yet understand, so I'm checking what they mean next.

Lots of similar funds with red tax chips and small minus figures, so the left side is hard to read. On the bottom right, Psagot's 86,492 corresponds to the cheapest pair at the top, an alternative S&P 500 tracker from Yelin Lapidot.

content.text: Table: "שנים 10 → 12, 18,436 ₪ יותר". OK, longer is better. Then "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" — don't know that, "-21.8%" scary. Skipping. Quick look at the rest.
Charts with minuses, I skip them. "הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים 86,492 ₪, ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500, פסגות". Same answer again.

I'd go with what the page calls the cheapest: open an account at Psagot (פסגות) and buy the Yelin Lapidot (ילין לפידות) S&P 500 fund. The page says that leaves about 86,500 ₪ after 10 years, against roughly 68,500 ₪ if I stayed at Hapoalim. I'm fairly sure, but those numbers are for the page's example, not my money: 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month. I didn't change it to my 30,000.

**What decided it:** the gap between account places, shown in shekels. Hapoalim, Leumi and Mizrahi come out around 15,000–18,000 ₪ worse. A difference like that I take seriously.

**What to do first:** open the Psagot account, then buy that fund every month.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד". S&P 500 was already picked, with 84,184 ₪ for "הבחירה שלכם" and 86,492 ₪ for "הזוג הזול ביותר".
- **Accounts list on the right.** "אינטראקטיב ישראל" is first, but I've never heard of it. The big banks are much lower.
- **Funds list on the left.** It's huge, with coloured tags on every fund. I scrolled past it, totally lost.
- **Bottom of the right side.** There I found Psagot at 86,492 ₪ with "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", the same number as at the top. The "86,492 הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים" chart further down showed it again.
- **The rest.** The "מה הכי משנה" table I only glanced at: more years means more money. The currency-hedging part and the charts I skipped. They had minuses like −21.8% and I don't get them.

**Words I didn't get:** צוברת, מס דיבידנד בתוך הקרן, נטרול מט"ח / מנוטרלת מט"ח, 4D / 4A, דמי משמרת, W-8BEN, "מס גם על שינוי המטבע", "עוד לא נאסף", "אין נתון", "סטיית מעקב".

**Where it went wrong for me:**
- The left-hand list of about 19 near-identical funds with red tags. I'd have closed the page there if the cheapest pair hadn't been written at the top.
- The −533 ₪ and red chips made me nervous.
- I didn't move the sliders to my amounts.
- One more thing that bugs me: Psagot's box near the bottom says "אין נתון", and there's a grey line I barely noticed, something like "יש ספק אם נכתבת שם: פסגות". So maybe its price isn't certain.
